versions.changelog:
- Element Plus 中文文档技能首次发布。
- 集成官方 83+ 组件 API、可复制 Vue 3 示例、设计指南与快速上手。
- 明确组件 API 查询、代码示例、表单/表格/布局/集成等典型触发场景。
- 划定非适用范围：其他 UI 框架、纯 Vue 3 核心、Vue 2/Element UI 等问题不触发。
- 详细文档索引与拆分，便于模块化查阅；单组件/指南独立文件。
- 附带大量中文代码示例及常见需求速查指导。

Initial release of the “element-plus-docs” skill — your complete Chinese reference for Element Plus with code examples and API lookups.

- Integrates Element Plus official docs: 83 components, usage demos, and design guides.
- Provides ready-to-use Vue 3 (`<script setup>`) code examples for common UI patterns like tables, buttons, forms, and notifications.
- Supports quick lookup of component API attributes, events, slots, and exposes, all in Chinese.
- Designed to trigger automatically when users ask about Element Plus, el-xxx components, or related Vue 3 integrations.
- Features a modular document structure for fast, targeted access; each component and guide in its own file.
- Includes guidance for searching components, extracting code, and answering typical Element Plus development questions.
